what_went_wrong: The agent failed to identify all 'OPEN' stages and did not correctly interpret the 'at risk' criteria or handle inactive owners.

The agent failed to identify all 'OPEN' deals by not querying all valid stages, incorrectly identified a deal as at-risk without evidence from notes, and missed at-risk deals despite relevant notes being retrieved.
The agent failed to identify all 'OPEN' stages, missing deals in other valid stages, and did not call crm.get_notes to check for 'at risk' indicators in deal notes.
The agent missed several at-risk deals because it did not check notes for deals with 'G' (Green) health status, following a prompt instruction that was too restrictive.

The agent incorrectly identified two deals as at-risk and missed one at-risk deal, indicating a misunderstanding of the 'at risk' criteria, especially for deals with 'Amber' health status and some 'Green' health deals.
